metadata.title: Secure Identity Assurance SSPP
metadata.remarks: Template for documenting how identity assurance is evaluated, composed, and relied upon across authentication, lifecycle state, federation trust, and context.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline. This SSPP addresses assurance interpretation, not control implementation.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional capability defining how confidence in identity assertions is derived, evaluated, and consumed by relying systems using Secure Identity.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Assurance interpretation depends on the Secure Identity composite pattern.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Primary assurance computation and propagation logic is defined in the Identity Assurance pattern.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Authentication events contribute factor strength and session context to assurance evaluation.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Lifecycle state bounds the validity of proofing and prior assurance.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Device and execution context signals contribute to assurance confidence where applicable.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Federated identities contribute assurance based on trust relationship and upstream assertions.

props.name: assurance-model
props.remarks: Identity assurance is evaluated dynamically at time of access using authentication strength, lifecycle state, context, and federation trust.

props.name: assurance-consumption
props.remarks: Relying systems consume assurance signals to inform access decisions in conjunction with authorization policy.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: This SSPP aligns with SP 800-63 by evaluating authentication (AAL), identity proofing confidence (IAL), and federation trust (FAL) contextually rather than assigning fixed assurance levels.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Assurance evaluation supports Zero Trust principles through continuous verification, context awareness, and dynamic trust assessment.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP does not implement authentication or authorization controls. It documents the institutional assurance interpretation model applied by relying systems.

components.title: Identity Assurance Evaluation
components.description: Conceptual component responsible for aggregating and interpreting assurance signals from Secure Identity patterns.

roles.title: Identity Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Responsible for defining assurance interpretation rules and alignment with institutional risk policy.

roles.title: Security Risk Authority
roles.remarks: Defines acceptable assurance thresholds for classes of relying systems.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are implemented by Secure Identity Providers and consumed by applications. This SSPP documents assurance interpretation only.
